caseNameFull: LeRea v. Cochran, Director, Division of Corrections Whiting v. Sacks, Warden and Duke v. Ellis, Director, Texas Department of Corrections
attorneys: Richard W. Ervin, Attorney General of Florida, and Reeves Bowen, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent in No. 581, Mise.

opinions.text:
Motions for leave to file petitions for writs of habeas corpus denied. Treating the papers submitted as petitions for writs of certiorari, cer-tiorari is denied.

Reported below: 115 So. 2d 545.
